text: (1) Foreign nationals who are at least 17 years old (scholarship applicants must not be older than 23 years old as of September 1, 2025); (2) In good health (a formal hospital's "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" is required); (3) Excellent academic performance and good potential for learning during high school; (4) For those applying for the preparatory scholarship, the following conditions must also be met: 1) Grade point or average score (grade level): Good or above; 2) Chinese language proficiency: HSK Level 3 or above; 3) Meet the admission requirements of the undergraduate application institutions; 4) Have not received any other types of scholarships from the Chinese government simultaneously.
